prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 电子发票常见问题 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 13px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "问题" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 253px
  col 2: header "回答" · longest unbreakable word 27px · one-line width 1248px
  col 3: header "相关链接" · longest unbreakable word 175px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 538px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 537px.
Fixed: content, font, 13px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者查找电子发票的常见问题，并阅读对应的解答和相关链接。","reading":"读者先扫描首列问题，找到所需主题后横向阅读回答，再按需使用同一行的链接；回答较长，预计会决定多数行的高度，问题和链接可在这些行高中适度换行。","groups":["问题与回答构成每行的问答对，应通过同一行的对齐关系保持关联。","相关链接是各问题的补充入口，与同一行的问答关联，但承担导航而非解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["相关链接中最长的连续字符串，至少需要175px文字宽度。","问题和回答中的连续词语及标识符应保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["问题可按中文自然断行，但应保持易于逐行扫描。","回答可按中文自然断行；长回答会形成较高的行。","链接文字中允许断行的部分可换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [125, 216, 196] · table 538×898px · row heights [33, 154, 134, 134, 154, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [170, 171, 196] · table 538×1099px · row heights [33, 174, 174, 174, 174, 194, 174] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [100, 217, 220] · table 538×898px · row heights [33, 154, 134, 134, 154, 154, 134] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"问题列有足够宽度，多数问题以两三行呈现，便于扫描；回答与对应问题同排，链接列也容纳了最长连续字符串。","problems":"回答仍较窄，长段落形成高行；两个发票查验链接在域名中间换行，链接列下方也留下大片空白。","cause":"回答列为216px，文字宽度仅195px；链接列为196px，虽能容纳175px连续字符串，却不足以容纳完整的查验网址。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"170px的问题列让问题多以两行呈现，主题容易扫读；链接保持在对应行内。","problems":"回答被压成很窄的文字带，多数行高显著增加，问题和链接旁出现大块空白，横向阅读问答对的节奏被拉长。","cause":"问题列增至170px后，回答列只剩171px，其中可用文字宽度为150px；链接列仍为196px，查验网址依然换行。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"220px的链接列让展示的网址完整单行，查验入口更易辨认；217px的回答列与r0A有相近的行高。","problems":"问题列过窄，多数问题被切成三四行，词组和问句的阅读节奏零碎；链接列相对稀疏，整表左右的文字密度失衡。","cause":"问题列仅100px，文字宽度为79px；为了让链接完整单行，链接列占用了220px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-answer","widths":[125,225,187],"change":"以r0A为基础，将链接列收至187px，把9px交给回答，同时保留适合扫描的问题列；链接中的长连续字符串仍有166px文字空间，需检查是否会导致拆分或溢出。"},{"name":"balanced-safe","widths":[115,226,196],"change":"保持链接列196px，确保175px连续字符串完整；从问题列移10px给回答，测试更宽回答是否减少换行，同时观察问题的可读性。"},{"name":"single-line-links","widths":[115,209,213],"change":"在r0C基础上将问题列加宽15px，并缩减链接与回答列；测试213px链接列能否继续容纳查验网址单行，同时改善问题扫描。"}]}
